completion_threshold_ratio.description: 35% screen width traversal required to commit interactive pop without momentum

horizontal_fraction.description: Left 67% of top screen boundary (spanning from x=0 to left edge of CC zone)

disabled_conditions: Face ID / passcode modal authentication prompt active
Screen recording privacy banner active lock

right_fraction.description: Rightmost 33% of top edge (right of Dynamic Island notch on iPhone18,3)

disabled_conditions: Screen lock if CC disabled on lock screen in Settings
Active camera capture shutter touch tracking

home_bar_region_height_pt.description: Bottom safe area home indicator touch strip height (34.0pt on standard iPhone)

inter_gesture_conflicts.name: Top-Left Corner Conflict (NC Pull vs Back Swipe on iPad/Landscape)
inter_gesture_conflicts.region: Top-left corner box (x in [0, 20pt], y in [0, 20pt])
inter_gesture_conflicts.resolution_mechanism: Vector angle discrimination in _UISystemGestureGate: if dy > dx * 1.732 (angle > 60 deg downward), NC pull claims touch; if dx > dy * 1.732 (angle < 30 deg rightward), Back swipe claims touch; neutral 30-60 deg zone requires 20pt displacement before committing.

inter_gesture_conflicts.name: Top-Right Corner Conflict (CC Pull vs App Navigation Bar Controls)
inter_gesture_conflicts.region: Top-right corner box (x >= screen_width - 120pt, y in [0, 20pt])
inter_gesture_conflicts.resolution_mechanism: _UISystemGestureGate delays touches began to bar buttons by 150ms. If downward pull exceeds 20pt / 250pt/s, CC claims gesture and cancels button highlighting. If touch lifts before 150ms or moves < 10pt, tap is delivered to right bar button.

inter_gesture_conflicts.name: Bottom Edge Conflict (Home Switcher vs Reachability vs App Scroll)
inter_gesture_conflicts.resolution_mechanism: Directional gate: upward drag vector (dy < 0) commits SBHomeGesturePanGestureRecognizer (Home / Task Switcher); downward drag vector (dy > 0) commits _UIReachabilityGestureRecognizer; userland scroll views completely excluded from bottom 34pt strip unless preferredScreenEdgesDeferringSystemGestures includes UIRectEdgeBottom.

inter_gesture_conflicts.name: Two-Stage Edge Pull Protection (screenEdgesDeferringSystemGestures)
inter_gesture_conflicts.resolution_mechanism: First edge swipe displays system affordance chevron without dispatching gesture. Only a second consecutive swipe within 3.0 seconds commits the system recognizer, preventing accidental app interruption during gaming or drawing.

HomeGesturePreventedByExclusionTrapezoid.description: Trapezoidal exclusion polygon over home affordance during virtual keyboard presentation (Landscape 10-key or iPad floating/split keyboard) preventing home bar mis-touches.

SystemGestureExclusionRects.description: Per-window rectangular regions where userland apps declare custom exclusion from system back gestures (e.g. video scrubbing sliders, audio wave scrubbers).
